subject.title: fix(gateway): stop listing IDENTITY.md as a core file editor tab

question: Should `agents.files.list` intentionally stop advertising `IDENTITY.md` to all gateway clients while retaining undocumented-or-specialized direct raw writes through `agents.files.set`?
rationale: This is a deliberate protocol-level compatibility change affecting Control UI, desktop, Android, and any external client that uses the discovery response; the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling.

options.title: Accept the single-editor contract
options.body: Merge after live proof confirms list clients no longer receive `IDENTITY.md` and explicit direct writes still succeed.

options.title: Keep identity discoverable
options.body: Retain the existing list response and solve raw-editor corruption through a different client or API-level ownership mechanism.

recommendation.title: Accept the single-editor contract
recommendation.body: Merge after live proof confirms list clients no longer receive `IDENTITY.md` and explicit direct writes still succeed.

likelyOwner.reason: The related merged refactor and this follow-up both define the gateway workspace-file contract.
